limits: Originals are engineering-heavy, not ten independent business domains.

All later new-original runs are exposed regressions; original gold and first predictions remain unchanged.
No hard case is removed, no gold is edited, and no pending/unread fact is counted as correct.
Full-output precision has NOT been fully re-annotated this round; remaining false positives/conflicts are explicitly documented.
An independent human reviewer is still required before formal production acceptance.
